# An Old Hope

An Old Hope brings its namesake palette to Obsidian: deep charcoal backgrounds and warm off-white text, with red for actions, cyan for links and strings, yellow for headings and functions, green code accents, orange highlights and purple constants. The same colours run through the app shell, the editor, reading view, callouts, graph view and canvas, so syntax highlighting and Markdown presentation stay consistent.

![An Old Hope screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/banastas/an-old-hope-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "An Old Hope"
    author: "Bill Anastas"
    repo:   "banastas/an-old-hope-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "an-old-hope"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/an-old-hope"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/banastas/an-old-hope-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/banastas/an-old-hope-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a dark An Old Hope–inspired color palette with deep charcoal backgrounds, warm off-white text, red actions, cyan links/strings, yellow headings/functions, green code accents, orange highlights, and purple constants. Style the app shell, editor, reading view, callouts, graph view and canvas for consistent syntax highlighting and Markdown presentation."
}
```
